image_description: A close-up, high-angle view of a white electric steam iron resting on a patterned fabric surface. The image highlights the glossy white plastic body, the handle, and the metallic soleplate with visible steam vents. A power cord with a speckled beige sheath extends from the rear. A label with text is visible on the side of the iron's body.

artifact_observations.location: Label on the side of the iron body
artifact_observations.reasoning: The text on the silver label is distorted and illegible. Characters appear melted or fused together, which is a common AI artifact when rendering small print.
The transition where the speckled cord enters the white plastic body is slightly soft and lacks a clear mechanical strain relief or grommet detail, appearing somewhat 'melted' into the casing.
The boundary between the metal soleplate and the white plastic housing is slightly irregular and wavy, lacking the crisp, manufactured straight line expected in a real product.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the object is correctly classified as an iron and not a similar appliance (e.g., steamer).
To rigorously analyze the illegible/gibberish text on the side label, a key potential artifact.
To check for edge bleeding or fusion between the metal plate and the plastic body, especially at the tip.
To assess general coherence, lighting consistency, and subtle texture anomalies in the plastic and metal surfaces.

focus_areas: Legibility and structure of text on the side label
Sharpness and continuity of the boundary between the metal soleplate and plastic housing
Mechanical plausibility of the power cord attachment point
Regularity and physical correctness of the steam vent holes
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the text on the label; AI often fails here. Check if the steam holes are uniform or if they show signs of melting/warping. Verify if the reflection on the metal soleplate is consistent with the surrounding lighting environment.
